answer: An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the fable index resolves every citation against the zephyr checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the sparrow audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 1157 identities would post 4482 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
